title: Auto Format After Agent Code Edit Hook
description: Add automatic code formatting after every agent post-edit of code in the PostToolUse hook handler. When HookAgentToolCodeEditEnded fires, run the formatter on the edited file using the existing runFormatterAfterAutofix infrastructure.
summary: Decoupled formatter from autofix. Added runFormatterForFile which only runs the language-appropriate formatter (no fallback text cleanup). The HookAgentToolCodeEditEnded dispatch now calls runFormatterForFile instead of runFormatterAfterAutofix.
